# Example input for tests only (hand-written, not from a real aircraft)
board_name SPEEDYBEEF405V4
feature AIRMODE
serial 1 64 115200 57600 0 115200
aux 0 0 1 1800 2100 0 0
set serialrx_provider = CRSF
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT600
set dshot_bidir = ON
set motor_poles = 14
set rpm_filter_harmonics = 3
profile 0
set p_roll = 48
set d_roll = 34
rateprofile 0
set roll_rc_rate = 100
